title: To ArXiv or not to ArXiv: A Study Quantifying Pros and Cons of Posting Preprints Online
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure anything related to faith or religion. Its focus is on the academic peer-review process, specifically quantifying the effects of posting preprints online on author anonymity and paper visibility.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion as its subject matter is the process of academic publishing and peer review in computer science conferences.
